§6Saturnite

§aHeat-resistant superalloy that makes bullets catch fire and blocks antimatter explosions.

§bSaturnite§f is a durable, heat-resistant, corrosion-resistant alloy. Hard but brittle. Excellent neutron reflector. Its properties are, frankly, bizarre.

§6Production§f (§bRotary Furnace§f):
• Standard: 250 mB Reformate Gas + Copper Powder + 4x High-Speed Steel Powder → §e2 ingots§f
• Boosted: add Borax → §e4 ingots§f (double output)

§6Key Uses§f:
• §bAntimatter Containment Barrel§f, essential for antimatter storage
• Guns (bullets set targets on fire)
• §bAsteroid Mining Ship§f fuselage and shielding
• Fusion reactor lining and neutron shielding
• BF rocket fuselages
• Combine with meteorite ingot → §bStarmetal§f

§ePS:§f Always use the borax-boosted recipe if you have it. Double output for the same inputs. You will need a lot of saturnite for antimatter barrels and the asteroid mining ship.
